purpose: Named external-anthropometry references only; no execution probability, physical verdict or population hand synthesis

sources.title: U.S. Truck Driver Anthropometric Study and Multivariate Anthropometric Models for Cab Designs
sources.population: US Class-A CDL truck drivers; 15 states; collection January2008-March2009

landmarks.hand_length: right stylion at wrist to dactylionIII, palm on table

limitations: thumb-tip reach refers to whole-arm reach

sources.title: Firefighter Hand Anthropometry and Structural Glove Sizing: A New Perspective
sources.locations: Table2 p1363, Table7 p1367, AppendixA pp1374-1375
sources.population: US firefighters age18-65, four geographic locations,2009-2012
sources.protocol: right-hand 2D flatbed scan, fingers naturally open

landmarks.palm_length: wrist crease to middle base furrow

limited_derived_covariance.qualification: derived from rounded reported SDs; not raw covariance

limitations: Table2 male hand length197.6 differs from discussion/Table9 196.6
external landmarks are not rotation centres
glove-cluster quantiles are not whole-population quantiles

sources.title: Proportions of Hand Segments
sources.population: 66 clinical adults age19-78, suspected fractures excluded by radiographs; no bone pathology/deformity
sources.protocol: AP radiographs of both hands, right-hand summaries
sources.landmarks: interarticular phalangeal/metacarpal lengths and axial tissue distal to terminal bone
limitations: axial tissue is not pad radius

sources.title: ANSUR II Anthropometric Database

sources.population: US Army Active Duty, Reserve and National Guard
reports: Hotzman et al.(2011), NATICK/TR11/017 measurement handbook
sources.retrieval: official descriptive pages verified; raw files/manual/summary report not retrieved
limitations: do not naively pool supplied sex files
whole-hand measures do not supply digit joint geometry

sources.title: A multivariate analysis to propose linear models for the stature estimation in the Sabahan young adult population
sources.population: Sabahan university students age18-25; selected Malay,Chinese,KadazanDusun,Bajau strata; February2021-January2022
sources.units: source cm; derived aggregates mm and mm^2
sources.retrieval: original S1 acquired and analyzed; no identifying columns
limitations: raw correlations align approximately with Table7 rather than abstract/Table5
within-sex covariance still mixes four equally sampled ethnic strata
quantiles are sample estimates without population weights
wide flat span is not loaded fretting reach
